situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
In the filter area, click the label button "ui", then "bug", then the assignee button "Mika Ito", then "Ana Ruiz".
question: Which cards are shown, and what is the address?
answer: Only cards with both labels bug and ui whose assignee is either Mika Ito or Ana Ruiz: SL-109 in Backlog and SL-114 in Ready. The address is #/?labels=bug,ui&who=ana,mika.
